decision.exact_command_or_message: Wait up to 10 min for both replies and the status files. If imm26-4080-i4op9 stays silent or stuck, respawn a fresh operator (name not in this file, use <new>): powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/lane-brief.ps1 4080-i4 -Out C:/KenshiTestRuns/agents/<new>.brief.md -Name <new> -Predecessor imm26-4080-i4op9
decision.why: Respawn only if the operator stays silent, using the lane-brief form from the handoff; a live but slow operator is left alone.

decision.exact_command_or_message: powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/alert-ack.ps1 'LANE IDLE 5090-i5' 'op9 stopped at context; op9c took over the lane at 23:05 and is RUNNING; status check sent'
decision.why: The stale op9 idle is superseded, but ack only closes, so do it after op9c replies and the lane shows activity.

decision.exact_command_or_message: powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/alert-ack.ps1 'LANE IDLE 4080-i4' 'status check sent to op9; respawn if no status update'
